text_to_image_prompt:
Output one image, aspect ratio 125:104 (approximately 1.202:1), target canvas 1375 × 1144 pixels.

Create a 3-column by 2-row six-person portrait board without labels, thin pale dividers. CAST IDENTITIES, keep each person visually distinct: Kellan, an 18-year-old boy with fair lightly freckled skin, hazel olive-green almond eyes, soft straight brown eyebrows, tousled voluminous ash-brown waves falling over the forehead, a slim softly defined jaw, straight medium-length narrow nose, natural rose lips with a fuller lower lip, clean-shaven youthful face and slender athletic build.
Aria, a 17-year-old girl with fair lightly freckled skin, large gray-blue eyes, soft dark eyebrows, delicate oval face, small straight nose, full natural rose lips, long chestnut-brown hair loosely parted near the center, black rectangular eyeglasses and small gold hoop earrings.
Yuna, a 17-year-old girl with fair warm skin, a short honey-blonde side-parted bob with tousled waves, gray-green eyes, a softly angular jaw, straight small nose and natural pink lips; composed and observant.
Theo, a 17-year-old slim boy with fair freckled skin, dense short copper-auburn curls, green-brown eyes, a narrow youthful face, straight slender nose and a lightly playful closed-mouth expression; clean-shaven.
Mara, an 18-year-old girl with warm light olive-beige skin, scattered freckles across cheeks and nose, hazel-green almond eyes, thick dark softly arched brows, distinct cheekbones, full natural lips, a softly oval-square jaw, and long voluminous ash-brown waves parted in the center. Her hair has fine warm highlights, her face is youthful and she has no glasses.
June, a 38-year-old woman with warm fair skin, hazel eyes, a softly oval face with fine adult expression lines, chestnut-brown hair in a loose updo with face-framing strands, natural lips, warm steady gaze and small earrings.
Top row left to right: Kellan in gray hoodie and navy varsity jacket with hand in hair; Aria in dark-green sweater and white collar with cheek on palm; Yuna in burgundy blazer and white shirt. Bottom row: Theo in gray hoodie with black headphones around neck; Mara in faded brick-red raincoat, looking over her shoulder; June in cream knit and pale gray-blue apron, cheek resting in hand. Close chest-up crops, consistent individual facial identity and bright blurred interior backgrounds. Photorealistic live-action character photography, bright high-key cream-white exposure, soft frontal window daylight with generous fill, warm-neutral skin and pale ivory surroundings, low shadow density without flat or blown-out faces, subtle optical halation, realistic 50mm portrait perspective, fine individual hairs, faint freckles and visible natural pores. Youthful unretouched skin, restrained natural lips, no heavy makeup, oily gloss, plastic skin, HDR, dark teal-orange grading, anime or 3D rendering.
reproduction_note: 文字可复用构图、气质与质感，但随机采样可能改变脸部细节；未验证仅凭文字可达到近乎一致。需要严格锁脸时请同时使用此图作为身份参考。
